user.title: Zentraly Account
user.description: Enter your Zentraly credentials. The next step collects your Android profile; no login is made yet.

change_password.name: •••••••• — Password: configured · Change
change_password.description: The value is stored and is not sent to the browser. Leave the field empty to keep it.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Zentraly session
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the official app session JSON here in Home Assistant, with token, user_id, firebase_token and device_guid. It must belong to the same account. Never paste a session into a chat or share it in logs. Obtaining the session is outside this integration.

reconfigure.title: Zentraly authentication
reconfigure.description: Choose how to renew this account session. Opening these options does not sign in.

reauth.title: Zentraly authentication
reauth.description: Choose how to renew this account session. Opening these options does not sign in.

credentials.title: Configured account credentials
credentials.description: The configured account is kept. A stored password is shown as configured: expand Change to replace it. Continuing does not sign in.

change_password.name: •••••••• — Password: configured · Change
change_password.description: The value is stored and is not sent to the browser. Leave the field empty to keep it.

auth_profile.title: Sign in and save
auth_profile.description: Submitting attempts one login and verifies the account before saving. It may affect other Zentraly sessions. Use your Android app data; HA does not obtain or renew Firebase tokens. Available secrets are shown as •••••••• — configured. Expand Change to replace them; leaving the input empty keeps the value. On new setup, an empty GUID uses a generated identifier whose acceptance is not yet validated. Login with this reconstructed profile still requires live validation.

data_description.device_guid: Android ID used by the app, not a session token.
data_description.mobile_os_version: For example API 33, not the marketing version Android 13.
data_description.firebase_token: FCM value captured from your app; different from the Zentraly session token.

change_device_guid.name: •••••••• — GUID: configured · Change
change_device_guid.description: The value is stored and is not sent to the browser. Leave the field empty to keep it.

change_firebase_token.name: •••••••• — Firebase token: configured · Change
change_firebase_token.description: The value is stored and is not sent to the browser. Leave the field empty to keep it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not validate the session. Local data was not changed; if login completed, it may have affected other sessions.
error.invalid_auth: Zentraly rejected the credentials or session.
error.invalid_session: Incomplete or invalid session. Check all four fields and their types.
error.wrong_account: The session could not be verified as belonging to the same account.
error.invalid_credentials: Check email and password; they cannot be empty or contain control characters.
error.invalid_profile: Invalid or incomplete Android profile. Check field types and secrets. If the saved profile is damaged, correct it in Credentials and Android profile.
error.auth_in_progress: Authentication is already in progress for this account. Wait for it to finish.
error.configuration_changed: The configuration changed while this form was open. Close it and open Reconfigure again.
